reviewer.summary: Update/rollback facts for pilot/public-launch @ source 8331185 (evidence 8a253b6). electron-updater 6.8.9 wrapped by apps/desktop/src/main/services/appUpdater.ts. Effective allowDowngrade=false at 8331185 (ordering fix present; executed in-process harness confirms the channel setter flips it to true and the post-set clamp restores false). Interrupted download: no resume, temp file lives in <cache>/@neuropausedesktop-updater/pending/temp-<name>, on failure the whole pending dir is emptied (no partial file left), next download starts from zero. Corrupt artifact: ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH from DigestTransform, pending dir emptied, nothing installed, installed app untouched; a cached artifact from a prior launch is re-hashed and discarded on mismatch or feed change. Incompatible OS: electron-updater compares os.release() (kernel version) to feed minimumSystemVersion with strict semver; neither published feed carries the field and electron-builder never emits it, so no OS-floor gate exists at update time (a macOS-style '12.0' value would be rejected as invalid and the update offered). Arch: mac feed is universal-only and filterFilesForArch keeps it on both arches; Windows is x64-only with no arch filter. Previous version: neither electron-updater nor the app keeps a copy of the old binary; Squirrel.Mac ShipIt strings show an owned-bundle temporary URL with restore-on-abort (semantics INFERRED); NSIS uninstalls the old version before extracting the new one; the release workflows OVERWRITE downloads/NeuroPause.dmg and downloads/NeuroPause-Setup.exe at fixed names (contradicts UPDATE-ROLLBACK.md:24 'kept immutable'). Explicit rollback: pickRollbackTarget is pure and tested (14/14 vitest at HEAD); rollbackTarget() has zero callers and is on no IPC channel; no downgrade/reinstall/revert code path exists. UPDATE_TRANSITION = NOT_MEASURED and ROLLBACK = NOT_MEASURED: no executed old->new transition or rollback exists anywhere under certification/public-launch*; registers 26/27/38 and 002/20/21/32 say the same.

verdicts.reason: No executed old->new update on any machine is evidenced in certification/public-launch*, 002, or docs; feed host recorded HTTP 530 (002/23). Mechanism facts were measured in-process only (harness against electron-updater 6.8.9 with a fake app adapter).
AUTOMATIC_ROLLBACK = NOT_SUPPORTED (allowDowngrade=false effective; no revert code; rollbackTarget() unwired). No feed-freeze or manual-reinstall rollback was exercised; registers 27/38/002-32 agree.
Effective allowDowngrade=false at 8331185 in wire() and setChannel(); channel-setter override reproduced and the post-set clamp verified by execution; older feed -> 'update-not-available'.

Check/download/precondition/native-error paths executed: app stays running, disk untouched, phase 'error'. Real ShipIt/NSIS failure on a machine NOT_MEASURED; Windows failures after spawn are unobservable by design.
No resume; temp file in pending/ ; on failure pending/ emptied (no partial left); next attempt is a full re-download from byte 0.
sha512 mismatch -> ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, pending/ emptied, nothing installed, installed app intact; cached artifacts re-hashed and discarded on mismatch or feed change.
Library supports minimumSystemVersion (kernel-version semver compare, invalid values pass), but neither feed carries it and electron-builder never emits it; no OS floor is applied at update time.
Universal-only mac feed passes filterFilesForArch on both arches; Windows x64-only with no filter. The arm64->universal step was not executed.

Neither the app nor electron-updater retains the old binary; ShipIt temporary-URL backup is INFERRED from strings and is not user-restorable; NSIS uninstalls old before installing new; server overwrites downloads/NeuroPause.dmg and NeuroPause-Setup.exe at fixed names.
pickRollbackTarget is pure and tested (14/14); rollbackTarget() has zero callers, is on no IPC channel, and no downgrade/reinstall/revert code exists.

facts.fact: DOWNGRADE POLICY (app side): wire() sets autoDownload=false, autoInstallOnAppQuit=false, allowPrerelease=allowsPrerelease(channel), channel=feedChannel(channel), THEN allowDowngrade=false; setChannel() repeats allowPrerelease, channel, THEN allowDowngrade=false.

DOWNGRADE POLICY (library): electron-updater's `set channel(value)` unconditionally executes `this.allowDowngrade = true` (documented: 'allowDowngrade will be automatically set to true ... set allowDowngrade explicitly after'). Executed harness: ctor default allowDowngrade=false; after allowDowngrade=false then channel='latest' -> TRUE; after channel then allowDowngrade=false -> FALSE; after channel='beta' -> TRUE again; after re-clamp -> FALSE. Therefore the 8331185 ordering yields an effective allowDowngrade=false in both wire() and setChannel().

DOWNGRADE POLICY (decision): isUpdateAvailable(): equal -> false; not isUpdateSupported -> false; staging miss -> false; newer -> true; older -> allowDowngrade && older. Executed with current 1.0.0-rc.30: feed 1.0.0-rc.29 & allowDowngrade=false -> false; equal -> false; 1.0.0-rc.31 -> true; 1.0.0 -> true; rc.29 & allowDowngrade=true -> true. Via checkForUpdates() with a fake provider: older feed & allowDowngrade=false emits 'checking-for-update' then 'update-not-available' with log 'Update for version 1.0.0-rc.30 is not available (latest version: 1.0.0-rc.29, downgrade is disallowed).'; older feed & allowDowngrade=true emits 'update-available' 1.0.0-rc.29.

An older-than-current feed is surfaced to the app as phase 'not-available' with available=null (identical to 'up to date'); the UI label for that phase is 'Up to date'. The 'downgrade is disallowed' reason is only in electron-updater's info log, which the app maps to log.debug.

The prior discovery register recorded allowDowngrade as 'effectively TRUE' (G2, e_allowDowngrade_false_semantics, rollback_summary.unintended_downgrade_path) - that was measured against the pre-fix ordering. At 8331185 the fix is present and the executed harness confirms effective FALSE; 26_UPDATE_REGISTER's 'allowDowngrade: false (set after channel assignment; fixed this branch)' is consistent with source.

facts.fact: FAILED UPDATE RECOVERY - install precondition: BaseUpdater.install() with no downloaded file dispatches 'error' 'No update filepath provided, can't quit and install', returns false and leaves quitAndInstallCalled=false (executed on an NsisUpdater instance). App-side installOnRestart() only invokes autoUpdater.quitAndInstall() when app.isPackaged && phase==='downloaded'; otherwise it silently returns status (no error, no event).

FAILED UPDATE RECOVERY - macOS install: with autoInstallOnAppQuit=false, MacUpdater.updateDownloaded() starts a 127.0.0.1 proxy, calls nativeUpdater.setFeedURL, dispatches 'update-downloaded' and resolves WITHOUT calling nativeUpdater.checkForUpdates (MacUpdater.js:219-227). quitAndInstall() then registers on('update-downloaded') and calls nativeUpdater.checkForUpdates() (:240-256). Executed with a stubbed native updater: after quitAndInstall -> native calls ['checkForUpdates']; a native 'error' ('Code signature ... did not pass validation') is re-emitted as MacUpdater 'error' and app.quit() is NOT called (0 quit calls); a native 'update-downloaded' -> handleUpdateDownloaded -> nativeUpdater.quitAndInstall() (autoRunAppAfterInstall default true).

Consequence on macOS: the app's 'downloaded' phase (UI 'Ready to install') means 'zip sha512-verified in pending/ and local proxy listening' - Squirrel.Mac has not fetched, signature-checked, or staged anything yet. Squirrel's code-signature validation runs only after the user clicks 'Restart to install'; a signature refusal at that point leaves the app running, and the app-side phase stays 'downloaded' until the 'error' event flips it to 'error'.

FAILED UPDATE RECOVERY - Windows install: NsisUpdater.doInstall() spawns the downloaded installer detached+unref with ['--updated', '/S' if silent, '--force-run' if requested, '/D=<dir>' if set]; spawnLog resolves true as soon as a pid exists; BaseUpdater.quitAndInstall() then setImmediate(app.quit()). Spawn failure with UNKNOWN/EACCES retries via elevate.exe; ENOENT falls back to shell.openPath. Any installer failure AFTER spawn is unobservable by the app (it has quit).

Windows NSIS update mode (electron-builder default template; electron-builder.yml declares no nsis.include/custom script): the installer kills/waits for the running app (CHECK_APP_RUNNING, extra sleeps when isUpdated), then runs the OLD version's uninstaller (`old-uninstaller.exe /S /KEEP_APP_DATA --updated _?=<installDir>`, up to 5 retries) BEFORE extracting the new files. The previous binaries are therefore removed before the new ones exist; a failure inside that window leaves no installed app (manual reinstall from NeuroPause-Setup.exe). User data is preserved (/KEEP_APP_DATA, --updated).

Crash-after-update: no code detects a failing new version or reverts the binary; recordVersion() only appends the running version to userData/update-history.json and logs the rollback target at debug level. Safe Mode (safe-mode.json) skips the plugin loader only; Reset Settings deletes update-prefs.json (channel pref reverts to the build-stamped default) but neither touches the app binary.

INTERRUPTED DOWNLOAD - mechanism: full downloads stream response -> [ProgressCallbackTransform] -> DigestTransform(sha512) -> fs.createWriteStream(destination) (fresh file, no append). No Range header or resume logic exists in the full-download path; only the differential (blockmap) path uses range requests. Destination is <cache>/pending/temp-<fileName>; createTempUpdateFile unlinks any leftover temp first; on success the temp is renamed to the final name with a 60x500 ms EBUSY retry.

INTERRUPTED DOWNLOAD - executed: task received temp path 'temp-NeuroPause-1.0.0-rc.31-universal-mac.zip', wrote 100 B, threw ECONNRESET -> executeDownload rejected with code ECONNRESET; afterwards <cache>/@neuropausedesktop-updater/pending/ is EMPTY (no partial or temp file left) and the cache root holds only 'pending'. Behaviour on the next attempt: no resume - validateDownloadedPath finds nothing, a new temp file is created and the payload is downloaded from byte 0.

Differential download (mac): used only when <cache>/update.zip from a previous SUCCESSFUL update exists and disableDifferentialDownload is false; any failure logs 'Cannot download differentially, fallback to full download' and performs a full download. A first-ever update is always a full download. On success the new zip is copied to <cache>/update.zip for future deltas.

Updater cache location: <app cache dir>/<updaterCacheDirName>/pending, with updaterCacheDirName '@neuropausedesktop-updater' baked into app-update.yml by electron-builder (also provider generic, url https://neuropause033.com/updates, channel beta). Read from the locally built, untracked (gitignored) dist outputs for mac and win - not from the published artifacts.

CORRUPT ARTIFACT - executed: a payload with the second half replaced, streamed through the real DigestTransform(sha512) into the temp file -> executeDownload rejected with code ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, message 'sha512 checksum mismatch, expected <feed sha512>, got <actual>'; pending/ EMPTY afterwards. Nothing is installed: install() requires downloadedUpdateHelper.file, which is only set by done() after a successful rename.

CORRUPT ARTIFACT - propagation: the ERR_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH error is dispatched as 'error' -> app phase 'error' with error=message -> UI badge 'Error'. The old app is intact: corrupt bytes never leave pending/ and are deleted; no installer/Squirrel step runs.

CORRUPT ARTIFACT - cached from a previous launch: getValidCachedUpdateFile reads pending/update-info.json {fileName, sha512, isAdminRightsRequired}, compares its sha512 to the current feed, checks the file exists, then RE-HASHES the file on disk; any mismatch -> emptyDir(pending) -> null -> fresh download. Executed: successful download wrote update-info.json + 65536 B zip; new instance with valid cache -> download task NOT invoked ('Update has already been downloaded'); bit-flipped cached zip -> warn 'Sha512 checksum doesn't match the latest available update' and re-download; feed sha512 changed -> info 'Cached update sha512 checksum doesn't match ... will be cleaned', pending emptied, re-download.

A feed entry with neither sha512 nor sha2 is refused before any download (ERR_UPDATER_NO_CHECKSUM); an unparseable feed version throws ERR_UPDATER_INVALID_VERSION from isUpdateAvailable (executed). Full ERR_UPDATER_* code set present in 6.8.9: ASSET_NOT_FOUND, BLOCKMAP_FILE_NOT_FOUND, CHANNEL_FILE_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_CHANNEL, INVALID_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION, INVALID_RELEASE_FEED, INVALID_SIGNATURE, INVALID_UPDATE_INFO, INVALID_VERSION, LATEST_VERSION_NOT_FOUND, NO_CHECKSUM, NO_FILES_PROVIDED, NO_PUBLISHED_VERSIONS, OLD_FILE_NOT_FOUND, RELEASE_NOT_FOUND, UNSUPPORTED_PROVIDER, WEB_INSTALLER_DISABLED, ZIP_FILE_NOT_FOUND.

facts.fact: Authenticity beyond sha512 - Windows: NsisUpdater.verifySignature() returns null (verification skipped) when app-update.yml has no publisherName; the built app-update.yml has none; electron-builder.yml declares no win.publisherName; app-builder-lib injects publisherName only when Windows code-signing verification is forced. Executed: verifySignature() returned null and a custom verifyUpdateCodeSignature hook was never called. Windows updates are therefore sha512-only.

Authenticity beyond sha512 - macOS: electron-updater JS performs no signature check; Squirrel.Mac does. Strings present in node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Frameworks/Squirrel.framework/{Squirrel,Resources/ShipIt}: 'verifyCodeSignatureOfBundle:', 'Code signature at URL %@ did not pass validation', 'Could not get code signature for running application', 'verifyAndPrepareUpdate:fromBundle:', 'SQRLCodeSignature'. INCOMPATIBLE UPDATE - OS floor logic: checkIfUpdateSupported() compares os.release() (kernel version; 25.5.0 on this host) with updateInfo.minimumSystemVersion via strict semver.lt; absent field -> supported; comparison error -> warn and treat as supported. Executed: minimumSystemVersion '99.0.0' -> not available ('Current OS version 25.5.0 is less than the minimum OS version required 99.0.0'); '12.0' (macOS-marketing style) -> 'Failed to compare ... Invalid Version: 12.0' and the update IS offered; '1.0.0' -> offered.

INCOMPATIBLE UPDATE - no OS gate in practice: neither published feed carries minimumSystemVersion (mac-beta-mac.yml and win-beta.yml have only version/files/path/sha512/releaseDate); electron-builder.yml sets no mac.minimumSystemVersion; app-builder-lib writes mac.minimumSystemVersion only to Info.plist LSMinimumSystemVersion and no code under app-builder-lib/out/publish emits it into the feed. The updater therefore applies no OS floor at check time.

facts.fact: Built macOS app declares LSMinimumSystemVersion 12.0 (verifier gate PLIST ok). If a client below that floor were offered the update, the updater would install it and the OS would refuse launch - recovery is manual reinstall. Hypothetical: electron 42 itself already requires a newer macOS than any such client would run.

INCOMPATIBLE UPDATE - architecture: MacUpdater.filterFilesForArch keeps only arm64-named files on arm64/Rosetta Macs when any exist, and only non-arm64 files otherwise; 'universal' names contain no 'arm64', so the universal zip is selected on both arches; findFile prefers a name containing process.arch, else the first .zip. Windows feed is a single x64 NSIS exe and NsisUpdater applies no arch filter (findFile 'exe'). The rc.29 (arm64-named) -> rc.30 (universal) transition claimed in UPDATE-ROLLBACK.md:18 is a code-derived expectation, not an executed transition.

PREVIOUS-VERSION PRESERVATION - updater/app: electron-updater keeps no copy of the running app. Retained artifacts are only <cache>/update.zip (copy of the NEW zip for future differential downloads) and pending/ (cleared on failure). The app's update-history.json holds version strings only, no binaries.

PREVIOUS-VERSION PRESERVATION - Squirrel.Mac ShipIt (Electron.app/Contents/Frameworks/Squirrel.framework/Resources/ShipIt, 125,584 B, present in node_modules/electron/dist) carries strings 'initWithOriginalURL:temporaryURL:codeSignature:', 'SQRLInstallerOwnedBundle', "Moving bundles via 'Contents' folder rename", "Couldn't abort install and restore owned bundle to previous location %@, error %@", 'Try installing the update again.', 'clearQuarantineForDirectory:', 'ShipItState.plist'. Reading: the existing bundle is moved to a temporary URL during install and restored if the install aborts; the temporary copy is not a user-accessible rollback. Whether the shipped NeuroPause.app's Squirrel.framework is byte-identical to node_modules/electron/dist was not checked.

facts.fact: PREVIOUS-VERSION PRESERVATION - server: macos-release.yml copies the DMG to the FIXED name /opt/neuropause-site/website/downloads/NeuroPause.dmg and windows-release.yml to downloads/NeuroPause-Setup.exe - each publish overwrites the previous installer. This contradicts docs/public-launch/UPDATE-ROLLBACK.md:24 ('previous signed DMG/installer (kept immutable under downloads/ with its digest)').

EXPLICIT ROLLBACK - primitive: pickRollbackTarget(current, history) returns the highest history entry strictly older than current, else null; pure, no side effects. Unit tests: 3 cases at updateChannels.test.ts:74-87. Executed at HEAD: `npx vitest run src/main/services/updater/updateChannels.test.ts` -> 1 file, 14/14 passed, vitest 1.6.1, 785 ms.

EXPLICIT ROLLBACK - wiring: pickRollbackTarget is called at appUpdater.ts:193 (inside rollbackTarget()) and :237 (inside recordVersion(), result only log.debug'd). rollbackTarget() (appUpdater.ts:192-194) has ZERO callers in apps/ and packages/ (grep matches only its definition); it is not part of UpdateStatus (:178-189) and not on any IPC channel - update:* channels are getStatus, checkNow, download, installOnQuit, setChannel only. AUTOMATIC_ROLLBACK for the desktop updater is NOT_SUPPORTED by design: allowDowngrade=false means an older feed is refused (harness C), and no revert code exists. Documented recovery is feed freeze/replace on the host, manual reinstall of a previous signed artifact, or a forward-fix release; the DR guide and release-operations doc call the rollback surface 'advisory'. FUTURE-VISION targets automated rollback at 1.1.0.

STALE APPROVAL: a downloaded-but-uninstalled artifact is re-validated against the CURRENT feed sha512 on every later download() call (feed change -> cache discarded, executed test 6), so a stale cached payload cannot be installed once the feed moves on across launches. Within a single session, however, install() uses the in-memory downloadedUpdateHelper.file with no re-check against the feed at install time.

CLIENT NOT FINAL AUTHORITY: payload acceptance depends on the server-published sha512 (feed) and, on macOS, Squirrel's code-signature check; the YAML feed itself is unsigned and the generic-provider host over TLS is the trust root; on Windows (no publisherName) the sha512 self-consistency of feed+payload is the only check.
